description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Order of impose Special Commodity Levy on Fish, Yogurt, Butter, etc., w.e.f. 01.10.2018
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory measures specifying tax rates for various commodities, which falls under legal/regulatory matters (new regulations and statutory instruments). While it mentions a minister by name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to create regulations, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
